crossRefs.note: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
“Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into Yahweh’s house, into one of the rooms, and…
In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”
translations.bsb: Then a voice said to him: “Get up, Peter, kill and eat!”
translations.kjv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
translations.asv: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill and eat.
